_meta.pocket: West-downtown Toronto corridor: Queen West, Ossington, Dundas West, Kensington, Little Italy, King West, Roncesvalles, The Junction
_meta.provenance: Compiled 2026-11-04 from each shop's own website or public booking platform profile (Booksy, Squire, Fresha, Square, Acuity, Setmore). Expanded and re-verified 2026-11-04: all 30 original entries were checked against current platform/shop data and 15 shops were added. The sandbox for that pass blocked direct fetches of booking platforms, so verification and new-shop sourcing are search-derived (extended web search snapshots of the platforms' and shops' own pages); per-listing notes say which source each menu came from. Prices are as published there; durations are typical estimates where the source did not publish one (see per-listing notes). No ratings are included because we have no authorized rating source. The sync script verifies every bookingUrl responds before a listing goes live and drops entries whose URL fails.
_meta.exclusions: Excluded on purpose, with reasons, as of 2026-11-04. Closed or closing: The Mad One (256A Queen W; Yelp page updated Aug 2026 is titled CLOSED and Squire shows Currently Closed), Bellwoods Barbers (closed per blogTO), Cameron House Barbers (408 Queen W; shop post dated 2025-11-28 announced Dec 30 as last day), Driven Barber (2005 Dundas W; blogTO marks NOW CLOSED). Stale/renamed listings at live addresses: Glassbox Roncesvalles (now MDRN, listed), Mr. Barber / Mister Barber at 3270 Dundas W (prior name of Cornerstone, listed), La Section Barbershop at 802 Dundas W (older/alternate name of 802 Barbershop, listed), Gents Barbershop (directory alias of Town Barber, listed), Joe's Barber Shop 541 College (likely stale listing next to GT8), Mi Hermano at 207 Augusta (alias at Rock Da House's address; the real Mi Hermano on Harbord is listed). No shop-published price or confirmed booking page: Ossington Barber Shop (735 Ossington; Fresha stub is call-to-book, only third-party prices), Apollo Barbers (499 Queen W; unclaimed Fresha stub, and Booksy now shows Compound Interest at this address), Compound Interest (499 Queen W; Booksy aggregate pages show Haircut $60/45min but its own profile URL could not be confirmed - relist once pinned down), Barberella (891 Dundas W; only a third-party from-$35), College Barber Shop (824 College), Blood & Bandages (895 College), Rod Gun & Barbers was promoted to listed after its own site's price page was found, Stag Head Barber Shop (2737 Dundas W; cash only, address unconfirmed), Jack's Barber Shop (903 Dundas W; possibly closed), Top Cuts Unisex (2845 Dundas W), Benny's Barber Shop (Junction; nothing confirmable), Barking Iron (1640 Queen W; operation unconfirmed), Point Blank Hair (1398 Queen W; cash only, mixed salon), Baz & Banks (Liberty Village; no online booking, address unconfirmed), Crowns and Locks (20 Vanauley; unverified), Proper Barbers (Kensington; unverified), Clippers Barbershop 884 College (template/demo site, possibly not a real shop). Salons, not barber-focused: Antidote Studio, Alibi Cutting Room, LES Studio, Silver Arrow, Golden Comb, Embu Hair, Tim' Barber, King's Landing Barber Shoppe (also no prices), Moretti Hair / Chroma Hair Shop, Nice Cut / Seefu / Haircut Hero / K-Two (Spadina), Toronto Hair Care. Address conflicts too risky to list: La Barberia (1153 vs 1572 Dundas W), Artistry Barbershop (1224 King W; multiple names at one address), P's Luxury Barber Suite / Pure Souls (424 Dundas W; Setmore booking disabled, conflicting addresses), A Q Barber (1502 Queen W; Fresha mixes it with Parkdale Barbers), Fade Room (431 Roncesvalles; address belongs to Moretti Hair). Out of the coverage pocket: 52 Barber Studio (52 Fort York Blvd, CityPlace; also no published prices), LMNT (282 Queen W, east of Spadina), Solidaire (150 Dundas W), Duke Barber Shop (750 Spadina, Bloor), FYF Studio (116 Dundas W), Gus The Other Barber (Koreatown), JDED (Yonge/Eglinton), Tony's Place (Financial District), BlackBox (East Bayfront), Garrison's on Jarvis (east downtown). Strong future leads pending one manual check: Hagen's solo haircut price (listed with its priced services), Mi Hermano's current from-price ($35 vs $50 across Fresha snapshots, listed at $50), Glassbox Ossington per-barber ranges (listed at from-prices).
_meta.coordsNote: fallbackLat/fallbackLng are approximate street-address coordinates used only when Mapbox geocoding is unavailable at sync time; the sync prefers a fresh geocode of the address.
